description: Handwritten demo about interpreting a passenger survey; not CGA data.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: I propose the heading 'Transit redesign improved reliability'. The published passenger survey reports higher satisfaction with service punctuality after the redesign.

utterances.speaker: Blake
utterances.text: That heading claims more than the survey measured. Reported satisfaction is not measured reliability, and the timing alone does not establish that the redesign caused the change.
